title: The Lift Has A Thirteenth Floor (Part 2) #shorts #horror
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story from Creepyville. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Last time, the lift took you to a thirteenth floor. And you were already home.
You should run. Instead, you walk in. Quietly.
It's your flat. But tidy. Boxes unpacked. Plants alive.
And on the sofa, there's you. Happy. Rested. Eating your favourite snack.
The other you looks up and smiles.
"Oh good, you're early. I did the unpacking. You're welcome."
"Relax," the other you says. "We take turns. Tonight, you sleep up here."
"I go down to twelve. I deal with the boxes."
It sounds like a really good deal. That's the scary part.
You sleep better than you have in years.
In the morning, you take the lift down to twelve.
Your old flat is perfect. Clean. Quiet.
*But all the family photos on the wall show the other you. And none of them show you.
A note is taped to the button panel. "Your turn for the boxes."
Tell me in the comments, and follow for more stories from Creepyville.
